text: Experts often discuss the difference between general AI, which handles specific tasks, and artificial general intelligence (AGI), which could understand and learn like a human. AGI might bring huge benefits, such as solving health problems or improving education. However, there are also serious risks. Some people worry about job losses, while others fear that AGI could become difficult to control. Predictions about when AGI will arrive vary greatly. Some experts believe it is still many decades away, while others think it could appear within twenty years. Because of this uncertainty, many researchers call for careful development and clear safety rules.
